summary: Two notification additions. (A) Per-destination snapshot delivery mode (all methods): each destination chooses 'inline' (embed the image — webhook/MQTT base64, Telegram photo) or 'link' (send only the reference: notification link + data.snapshotPath, no bytes), so payloads/broker messages stay small. NotificationDestination.SnapshotMode (default inline); renderVisionAlert skips attaching the image bytes in link mode while keeping the reference; a 'Snapshot delivery' control appears in the destination card when the snapshot field is enabled. (B) New MQTT destination type — the industrial transport. infra/notification/mqtt_channel.go (eclipse/paho.mqtt.golang) publishes the shared canonical JSON (same shape as the webhook; webhook refactored to reuse notificationJSON) to a broker topic with QoS/retain, username/password, and TLS incl. mutual-TLS client-certificate auth (PEM CA/cert/key); background connect with auto-reconnect; topic supports {{token}} templating resolved from the payload data. domain ChannelConfig gains DestinationConfig.Mqtt + a 'mqtt' case in Configure; mymatasan NotificationMqttSettings on the destination, mapped in notificationChannelConfig, validated (broker+topic required, cert/key together). UI: 'Add MQTT' button + an MQTT destination card (broker/topic/client id/QoS/retain/username/password + TLS fieldset) reusing the sample-payload disclosure. README Notifications section documents both.
compatibility: Backward compatible. Existing webhook/Telegram destinations default to inline snapshot delivery (current behavior). New dependency github.com/eclipse/paho.mqtt.golang added to go.mod. The webhook payload shape is unchanged (the shared notificationJSON produces the same JSON as before).
